item.title: Country Blues Singer Elsie Splits ‘America’s Got Talent’ Panel With Confessional Original: ‘You Have Star Potential’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we're talking about the latest trends in music. Tonight, we're shining the spotlight on Elsie, a 32-year-old mom who took the stage on America's Got Talent.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: Elsie performed her original soul blues number, "Forgiveless", which had the judges talking. With her confident stage presence and a clap-along beat, she sang about washing away sins in the cold water. The audience loved it, but the judges had mixed opinions.
[Clip of Elsie's performance plays]
Host: Judge Sofia Vergara compared Elsie to Beyoncé, but didn't love the song. Mel B praised Elsie's "amazing" voice, but thought the song choice was a mistake. Howie Mandel agreed, saying Elsie looked and sounded like a star, but the backing track overpowered her vocals.
[Clip of judges' comments plays]
Host: Simon Cowell, however, thought Elsie had "everything it takes" to do well in the competition. He encouraged her to let go and be more raw, saying she had "star potential" and a "glow about her".
[Clip of Simon Cowell's comment plays]
Host: When it came time to vote, the judges were divided. Howie Mandel said no, but the rest of the panel voted to let Elsie through to the next round.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for tonight. Tune in to America's Got Talent on NBC, Tuesdays at 8 p.m. ET, or stream it on Peacock the next day. We'll be watching to see what's next for Elsie. Thanks for joining us! [Outro music continues to play]
